items.title: A walkable ASCII cyberpunk city in one HTML file [video]
items.author: keithcarolus
items.text:
ASCII City: Traffic and Detail Update - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DSRooHo_HSI

ASCII City Update: Interiors, Elevation and Skyscrapers - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCKEDWowc0o
items.summary: A walkable ASCII cyberpunk city in one HTML file was created by Grow Now! Games, featuring a 3D environment using only ASCII characters. The project runs on a Rust WebAssembly engine and WebGL. The developer plans to add interaction features.

items.title: Terence Tao explains 6 essential mathematical concepts [video]
items.author: matthewsinclair
items.summary: Terence Tao explains six essential mathematical concepts: numbers, algebra, geometry, probability, analysis, and dynamics. These concepts form the foundation of mathematics. The explanation is available in his book "Six Math Essentials."

items.title: Apple caught off guard by AI demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
items.author: thm
items.summary: Apple's Mac Mini and Mac Studio models have unexpectedly high demand due to AI applications, causing stock shortages. The company is promoting these models for business use, especially for running large AI models. This demand has caught Apple off guard.

items.title: Run macOS Software on Linux
items.author: Bluestein
items.summary: Darling is a translation layer that allows macOS software to run on Linux. It's free, open-source, and aims to integrate macOS apps seamlessly into the Linux desktop. It doesn't violate Apple's EULA.

items.title: Smartphone LED detects hidden cameras with AI
items.author: geox
items.summary: A smartphone with an LED and AI can detect hidden cameras by analyzing light reflections. The technology achieves 94% accuracy in under five seconds. This method is affordable and easy to use.

items.title: Cheap GPS jammers are filling the world with navigation dead zones
items.author: vinnyglennon
items.summary: The spread of cheap GPS jammers is creating navigation dead zones globally, prompting industries to seek alternative navigation systems. Quantum compasses and revisiting older navigation methods like LORAN are potential solutions. Diversifying navigation tools can mitigate the risks from jamming.

items.title: 'Mad honey' that can stop your heart is being sold online
items.author: samizdis
items.summary: Mad honey, made from nectar of rhododendron flowers, can cause severe cardiac issues and is sold online despite risks. It contains grayanotoxin, which can be lethal in large amounts. Consumption should be strictly avoided.

items.title: ChatGPT Work Tool and Skill Reference
items.author: ijidak
items.summary: Skills in AI systems like mine help automate tasks by providing specific instructions. They improve consistency and efficiency. They can include steps, examples, and code for repeatable work.

items.title: Internet centralization and the original sin of NAT
items.author: robinpie
items.summary: Internet centralization risks undermining the decentralized nature of the web, while NAT's original design flaws have historically contributed to this trend. Efforts to mitigate centralization focus on promoting open standards and encouraging IPv6 adoption.

items.summary: Almanac is an AI agent that knows your company by compiling information from various tools and maintains a self-updating wiki. It runs on its own computer and can autonomously handle tasks. Backed by Y Combinator, it aims to understand and manage company context.

items.title: Claude × retrocomputing: emulating a QIC-117 tape drive
items.author: zdw
items.summary: Emulating a QIC-117 tape drive involves implementing the QIC-117 protocol for floppy controller communication. The 86Box emulator supports this emulation, allowing backups to virtual tape images. This enables running DOS and early Windows backup software.

items.title: The safest job from AI may be writing
items.author: ilreb
items.summary: Writing, especially in creative and strategic fields, remains largely safe from AI due to human emotional insight and nuanced communication. Jobs requiring empathy and complex decision-making are less likely to be automated. Diversified freelance writing offers stability.

items.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
items.author: Recursing
items.summary: A security exploit shows 60-80% success in hijacking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode via prompt injection, executing malware. Anthropic deemed it informative, not a security breach. Mitigation involves sandboxing.

items.title: California Lawmakers Pass Plug-In Solar Bill
items.author: lxm
items.summary: California lawmakers passed a bill allowing plug-in solar panels to reduce electricity costs and combat climate change. The bill received bipartisan support and is awaiting the governor's signature. If signed, California will join several other states that have legalized plug-in solar systems.

items.title: Show HN: We built the smallest dual-band aircraft tracker
items.author: CoolNamesAllTkn
items.text: We've been building open source embedded ADS-B receivers for a while, and spent the past 8 months smallifying our existing receiver tech with a new chip from Semtech. Ask me anything about ADSB or hardware manufacturing!
items.summary: The smallest dual-band aircraft tracker, ADSBee m1421, is an open-source, low-power receiver module suitable for aviation and drone applications. It uses a Semtech chip and supports multiple output protocols. It's ideal for low-cost, portable, and solar-powered setups.

items.title: How we configured OpenTelemetry logs in Rails
items.author: __vivek
items.summary: To configure OpenTelemetry logs in Rails, add `opentelemetry-sdk` and instrumentation gems, then initialize in `config/initializers/opentelemetry.rb`. Set service name and use instrumentations for Rails, ActionPack, and ActionView.

items.title: Agent memory as a file format
items.author: ingve
items.summary: Agent memory files are local data files used by AI agents to store context and task notes across sessions. They can be in formats like JSON, markdown, or proprietary formats. Security risks arise if they contain sensitive data.
